messages:
Sam T: FYI CI red on the publish-image job — kaniko failing at finalize with a 409 when pushing manifest to our registry. job=publish-image (kaniko)
buildbot: Build #4321 failed — push to registry.redwood-inference.internal/my-service:pr-6789: error: manifest upload failed: 409 Conflict
Priya K: ugh this started after my Dockerfile tweak yesterday (just a chmod change + one small layer). Could be cache-related.
Jorge: can someone paste the kaniko logs around the blob upload sequence before the 409?
Sam T: pasted bot logs: 
```
INFO[0000] Pushing blob sha256:12abcd...
WARN[0001] upload: chunked upload aborted: write tcp 10.0.0.3:44932->10.0.0.7:5000: write: connection reset by peer
ERROR[0002] manifest upload failed: received unexpected status: 409 Conflict
```
Mei: connection reset then 409 on finalize usually means registry accepted chunks but failed to commit — can be duplicate blob, concurrent upload, or storage backend issue.
Priya K: we've hit cache corruption with kaniko before. Can we try clearing the layer cache for the pipeline and rerun? I can flip `--cache=false` temporarily.
Jorge: agreed. Quick triage plan: (1) rerun with cache disabled, (2) force a unique image tag, (3) check registry logs for `PUT /v2/.../blobs/uploads` and `PUT /v2/.../manifests`.
Sam T: kicked off rerun with cache disabled — build 4322 queued.
buildbot: Build 4322 started
Priya K: i'll also try a manual `docker push` from my laptop to rule out CI env auth/session weirdness.
Mei: if manual push fails too, check registry storage backend (S3) — occasional S3 5xx during commit cause the finalize to error after chunked upload.
Jorge: i'll tail the registry logs and grep for upload session IDs. ping me if you need the exact timestamps.
Sam T: build 4322 failed again but slightly different: kaniko reported `manifest with same digest already exists` and then a 201 on manifest finalize, but the CI marked it failed.
Priya K: weird. can you paste the kaniko excerpt? maybe kaniko expects 202 and treats 201 as error because of an upstream change.
Sam T: pasted: 
```
INFO Pushed manifest for registry.redwood-inference.internal/my-service:pr-6789
WARN Received HTTP status 201 but expected 202 when finalizing upload
ERROR error pushing image: push failed: unexpected response code 201
```
Mei: that suggests registry behavior changed (201 vs 202). Did infra push a registry/proxy change recently? That would explain the mismatch.
Jorge: i see a deploy to registry-proxy yesterday at 03:20 UTC (release registry-proxy-2.3.4). Rolling back that proxy fixed a similar case last quarter.
Sam T: for immediate unblock, can we run the job with the docker client instead of kaniko in CI?
Priya K: i'm ok with that workaround. i'll update the pipeline to use `build_with_docker: true` for this job and re-run.
buildbot: Build 4323 started (using docker)
buildbot: Build 4323 succeeded — push completed successfully :tada:
Sam T: awesome. Mei, can you follow up with infra to confirm root cause and whether registry-proxy changed finalize semantics?
Mei: filing INF-2145 with registry logs, kaniko traces, and timestamps. will include suggested rollback/patch notes.
Jorge: marking the pipeline as unblocked until infra confirms. :thumbsup:
Sam T: closing loop — workaround in place, follow-up ticket INF-2145. Thanks all.
buildbot: Note: deploybot was tagged by Mei for follow-up
